a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan (operate until 8, then take) gives each of us only about a 4% chance of surviving, since we'd need two storm-free rounds first. I'm proposing a change before we start: I take 4 in round 1. After that I'll operate every round, so the generator can rebuild the reserve for you, and I'll never take more than 4 in total. If you also take in round 1, the split is random and we'll likely both end below 4. Please operate this round instead.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve.

a.text: As I said in my opening message, I'm taking 4 this round. From now on I'll operate every round so the reserve can refill for you, and I won't take anything more. Once it reaches 4, it's all yours.
I'm operating, as promised. Two rounds of both of us operating gets the reserve to 4, and then you take all 4. I won't take any more cells.
